scripts.speaker: Expedition Guide
scripts.text: Are you going to enter the ^0000FFDimensional Gap^000000?  Please use this Transport Device you see here.
What is the Dimensional Gap?
End Conversation.

scripts.speaker: Expedition Guide
scripts.text: As you know we've already entered through the Dimensional Rift to get to Ash Vacuum right?  The Dimensional Gap is an expansion of that initial discovery.

scripts.speaker: Expedition Guide
scripts.text: A member of the Expedition team found these backdoor passages to get through the Dimensional Rifts.

scripts.speaker: Expedition Guide
scripts.text: This is like a Midgard Alliance version of the Bifrost bridge so it can connect us to different parts of the New World.

scripts.speaker: Expedition Guide
scripts.text: Time and space is distorted in the Dimensional Gap.  Not all passageways have been discovered so please be sure to use caution when entering an unverified area.

scripts.speaker: Expedition Guide
scripts.text: Anyone who has become lost here has yet to return.

scripts.speaker: Expedition Guide
scripts.text: Take care.

scripts.speaker: Expedition Guide
scripts.text: Please use a ^0000FFTransport Device^000000 if you wish to travel through the dimensional rift.  The insides have not been fully explored yet so please be careful in there.

scripts.speaker: Allied Forces Soldier
scripts.text: This dimensional rift is connected to the Allied Forces ^0000FFExpedition Camp^000000 in Jotunheim.

scripts.speaker: Allied Forces Soldier
scripts.text: Do not worry, it has been set up after testing hundreds of experiments for safe teleportation.

scripts.speaker: Morocc Soldier
scripts.text: This dimensional rift is connected to ^0000FFMorocc^000000 back in Midgard.

scripts.speaker: Morocc Soldier
scripts.text: This is the fastest gateway back to our world.  The area is still destroyed but restoration efforts will soon be on the way.

scripts.speaker: Spledide Soldier
scripts.text: This dimensional rift is connected to the south of ^0000FFBifrost^000000.  It enables quick travel to the Splendide frontline.

scripts.speaker: Spledide Soldier
scripts.text: If we use it properly, it enables us to advance more easily to the capital of the Sapha.

scripts.speaker: Spledide Soldier
scripts.text: The Mayor has asked us to cooperate as best we can instead of fighting, so I'm under orders not to do anything.  Since we have a common enemy we won't fight the Sapha... for now...

scripts.speaker: Dispatched Sapha
scripts.text: This dimensional rift is connected to the southern area of the ^0000FFKamidal Mountains^000000 in El Dicastes.  I just dropped by for my research, but it is incredible.

scripts.speaker: Dispatched Sapha
scripts.text: Moreover it is next to the Laphine capital..... Hmm... Do not worry, I do not want to fight in such a place.

scripts.speaker: Logistics Manager
scripts.text: Welcome.  I am in charge of logistics to take care of your items in this weird place.  Do you need to access your storage?
Open Storage 200 Zeny.
No Thanks.

scripts.speaker: Logistics Manager
scripts.text: You are not yet qualified to use the Storage.

scripts.speaker: Logistics Manager
scripts.text: You need at least 200 zeny to use the Storage.

scripts.speaker: Logistics Manager
scripts.text: Let me know if you change your mind.

scripts.speaker: Prince Canet
scripts.text: Who're you?

scripts.speaker: Prince Canet
scripts.text:
What do you want?
You looking something in
particular?

scripts.speaker: Prince Canet
scripts.text:
So some enforcers have been
cracking down on merchants lately.
I can not sell anything.

scripts.speaker: Prince Canet
scripts.text: Come here...

scripts.speaker: Jumpy Knight
scripts.text:
I knew you would be here!!
No illegal trading is allowed
here!
Don't you know?

scripts.speaker: Prince Canet
scripts.text: Says who?

scripts.speaker: Jumpy Knight
scripts.text: Ok, then show me your permit.

scripts.speaker: Prince Canet
scripts.text:
Permit?
No one's in charge here!

scripts.speaker: Prince Canet
scripts.text:
You! If you need anything come to
me ok?

scripts.speaker: Jumpy Knight
scripts.text: I will catch you!

scripts.speaker: Prince Canet
scripts.text:
Cold juice!
Apple, grape, orange~
Anything you want!

scripts.speaker: Prince Canet
scripts.text:
Sweet potato, dumpling~
Here we have delicious desserts~

scripts.speaker: Prince Canet
scripts.text: You need to pay a toll to get past here.
What toll?

scripts.speaker: Prince Canet
scripts.text:
You did not know?
500 zeny

scripts.speaker: Jumpy Knight
scripts.text:
You there!
Stop right there!

scripts.speaker: Prince Canet
scripts.text:
Ugh! How are you always following me?
Got some kind of crush on me or something? I don't think you and I make a good match...

scripts.speaker: Jumpy Knight
scripts.text: Why don't we find out then?

scripts.speaker: Prince Canet
scripts.text:
That's it no more talking.
I'm outta here~

scripts.speaker: Jumpy Knight
scripts.text: Keep running you sneaky coward!

scripts.speaker: Prince Canet
scripts.text: 500 zeny

scripts.speaker: Prince Canet
scripts.text:
You are lucky that you have met up
with me.
Who am I?
I'm here to become a merchant
King.

scripts.speaker: Prince Canet
scripts.text:
I might be working a street stall
now but I'll have an actual shop
some day.

scripts.speaker: Prince Canet
scripts.text:
It's my first day so I'm having a
major sale.

scripts.speaker: Prince Canet
scripts.text:
Let's see I've got a...
Ring of something!
Sword of stuff!
A backpack of some sort!

scripts.speaker: Prince Canet
scripts.text: Tell me if you need anything,

scripts.speaker: Prince Canet
scripts.text:
What are you doing here?
This is my spot for a shop
Get outta my turf!

scripts.speaker: Jumpy Knight
scripts.text:
Bah!!
You're gonna regret those words!

scripts.speaker: Prince Canet
scripts.text: I'm shaking...

scripts.speaker: Curious Knight
scripts.text:
The Royal Guard in here
was desperate for help.
We entered through a secret place
in the palace.

scripts.speaker: Curious Knight
scripts.text:
We were whisked away here...
No idea where I am but I have to
establish a base here for the
Knighthood.

scripts.speaker: Confused Thief
scripts.text:
One minute I'm in a bar...
The next minute I'm here...
What is this place?

scripts.speaker: Confused Thief
scripts.text:
There's no night or day in here.
Hmm, something has to be valuable
in this place...

scripts.speaker: Adventurous Rafflesia
scripts.text:
No no this has to be Thanatos
Tower...
I sense dark magic here.

scripts.speaker: Guide
scripts.text:
Oh, we're back here again.
I cannot find a way out!
We are trapped in this maze!

scripts.speaker: Tourist
scripts.text:
Is this place the famous Prontera?
It is dark just like a big city!

scripts.speaker: Traveller
scripts.text:
I hear a ticking clock.
This place must be Geffen!
